highlights_headline: Upcoming SkiaSharp 4.157 updates harden mask-filtered glyph rendering when consecutive font loads disagree.
highlights_body: Native fixes handle changed outlines, incompatible mask formats and clipped embossed glyphs without changing managed APIs.

bullets.detail: Mask filtering now uses the reloaded glyph's own outline and format, falling back to raster generation when no outline exists instead of using stale path data.

bullets.lead: Validate mask copies and preserve embossed planes
bullets.detail: Incompatible mask formats or non-overlapping bounds produce cleared output rather than unsafe copies or assertions. Clipped embossed glyphs preserve each plane's full stride and clear uncovered regions.
